decisions.reason: Retaining data during the new controlled redeployment does not necessarily restore NFTs from the earlier legacy contract. Discovery remains scoped to NFTs associated with the active replacement-contract flow.
The migration strategy preserves existing data but does not change the rule that only finalized successful mints may be counted or represented as owned NFTs.
The controlled contract redeployment and data-retention policy do not alter the badge set, icons, size, or layout.
The accepted deployment approach does not change the email authentication method, supported users, or dashboard-access behavior.
The source decision concerns technical migration and data continuity and does not require any specific change to the approved FAQ content.
The deployment strategy does not change the About-page content or resolve its separate prize-payout-copy ambiguity.
Retaining data during contract redeployment does not entail any change to landing-page copy, visibility rules, or layout.
The source establishes how fixes will be deployed while retaining data; it does not change automatic prize transfer behavior.
Preserving existing data during redeployment does not modify the requirement that referral, ticket, and payout figures be reported accurately.
The migration approach does not change the expected accuracy of prize-pool or platform statistics.
The controlled redeployment does not alter the no-referral commission amount, allocation trigger, or weighted recipient-selection rule.
The migration and data-retention decision does not change the optional tip feature, its amounts, or its follow-up transaction notice.
